services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: A fun-filled hour of games, songs, and stories. The perfect time and place for “acting up!” This class uses dramatic play to foster young children’s imagination, creativity, and social development. It goes beyond traditional playtime, offering a unique blend of storytelling, role-playing, and interactive games designed to spark their imagination and build confidence. All the fun with none of the effort! Build the basics of acting through games and activities celebrating your most creative “you.” Get a taste of stardom and explore the process of theatre training through high-energy theatre games, improvisation, and activities.
